name: Stadt Wien
body: HSTS with preload, a content security policy, security.txt, a sitemap, and a meta description on every page read. But on /stadtplan/, 183 of 188 inputs, mostly layer checkboxes, have no label to announce.
lesson: Give each checkbox a <label for>, or aria-labelledby pointing at its visible text.
summary: www.wien.gv.at scores 85 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 17 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: 183 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 183 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /stadtplan/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', object-src is not 'none', base-uri is not set.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 9 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: Security headers on the start page are missing on other pages
fix.evidence: Content-Security-Policy on 1 page, frame protection on 1 page, X-Content-Type-Options on 1 page, Referrer-Policy on 1 page, Permissions-Policy on 1 page, out of 19 pages read. Attackers pick the weakest page.
fix.fix: Set the headers once at the server, CDN, or host config so every response carries them.

fix.title: 4 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

fix.title: 3 script hosts are loaded without integrity checks
fix.evidence: assets.wien.gv.at, siteimproveanalytics.com, stadtservicebot.wien.gv.at. If that CDN is compromised, its code runs on the site.
fix.fix: Add integrity="sha384-…" and crossorigin="anonymous" to fixed-version CDN scripts.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
